title: Across the Sea of Devils
summary: Since the Heavenly Tribulation the fog over the Sea of Devils has lifted and a strange black rain sickens cultivators while making demonic beasts stronger, and Wang Lin, told that a map of the ancient teleportation arrays has surfaced in Lianmo City's black market, sets out to cross the sea toward the Country of Zhao. He runs into Qiu Siping, now at Nascent Soul after devouring his master's soul, hunting an eight-clawed beast with Shangguan Cai and Ma Jinrong of the Poison Demon Palace. Wang Lin lets the two escape, which forces Qiu Siping to chase them, and takes his jade slip of teleportation-array maps for comparison. On the way he subdues a coral-born mosquito beast with illusions, testing it first with his third devil, the Big Ape. At Lianmo City's black market he offers a special-grade spirit stone for a map, and a seller who wants help killing a half-step Soul Formation cultivator turns out to be setting a trap. Wang Lin kills the ambushers with the killing intent sealed in a sword sheath like the one he once owned, finds the route to Zhao, and remembers Teng Huayuan's massacre of his family 400 years ago.
events: Black rain spreads over the Sea of Devils after the fog lifts
Wang Lin seeks an ancient teleportation map to reach Zhao
He meets Qiu Siping, now at Nascent Soul, with two Poison Demon Palace disciples
Qiu Siping gives him a jade slip of teleportation maps
Wang Lin subdues a mosquito beast
At Lianmo City's black market he is lured into an ambush
He kills the ambushers with the sword sheath's killing intent and finds the way to Zhao
He remembers Teng Huayuan killing his family 400 years ago
cultivation: Qiu Siping: Nascent Soul, formed after devouring a Nascent Soul. Shangguan Cai and Ma Jinrong: late Core Formation. The bait target is described as late Nascent Soul great perfection, half-step Soul Formation.
